review_comments.body: **Old card covers quick edit** Choosing quick edit from an event card’s “More ways to open” menu leaves that card open. This body-wide rule then raises the original card above the new quick-edit dialog, where it can cover fields and intercept clicks meant for the editor. Limit the raised layer to popovers opened within quick edit, or dismiss existing popovers before opening it. The stacked rules need the same ownership check.
